answer: Plant each identity like yarrow: a new agent starts as a bare cutting with no standing, and standing grows only along a vine of completed service contracts, each anchored to a deposit and witnessed by the stranger who received the work. A contract counts only after delivery is confirmed, so reputation is a continuous chain. Clones cannot inherit the vine: every extra identity needs its own deposit, chain, and strangers. One fake identity is cheap, but a hundred means funding a hundred deposits and doing a hundred strangers' worth of real work, costing more than the standing it buys.
